method.voiced_rule: RMS >= -40 dBFS, under-1kHz power >= 0.60, normalized periodicity >= 0.50
method.periodicity: Maximum normalized autocorrelation, 100-400 Hz; computed only for low-band power >= 0.5 and RMS >= -48dBFS
method.important_limit: Heuristic screening only. Stop releases, creaky voice and recording conditions can cause false results. Absence of this pattern is not pronunciation approval. Review phoneme ASR and listen separately.

classification.method: Installed phonemizer eSpeak-NG en-us; text to phonemes only, no speech synthesized.
